name: codebase-layout
description: WHEN designing, auditing, or migrating physical source trees, packages, build targets, placement rules, or import-direction enforcement; NOT for one module's logical types and caller contract (architect), repository-wide architecture hotspot triage (architecture-audit), or semantic ports-and-adapters rules (hexagonal-architecture); produces an evidence-backed layout, dependency rules, proportionate enforcement, and a staged migration plan.
